description: Effects of flooding on Lagos metropolis is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by figshare. Flooding has become a persistent and destructive hazard affecting Lagos Metropolis, Nigeria, resulting in widespread socio-economic, infrastructural, and environmental challenges. This study investigates the causes, effects, and mitigation responses to flooding in five local government areas within the cit; Agege, Alimosho, Surulere, EtiOsa, and Idi-Araba. Coverage: Nigeria. The portal files it under the publisher figshare. Its tags are Environmental geography. The repository dates the deposit 2025; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
